explanation: This test only verifies that the wallet balance increases after a top-up of SGD 500. It does not verify that the FX rate is locked at initiation (fx_lock), nor does it verify that the destination wallet is credited before the funding source is debited (credit_before_debit). It also does not test the dual approval requirement for top-ups above SGD 10,000 (dual_approval). The test misses assertions about the order of operations and the locking of the FX rate. It also misses testing the rollback behavior on payment provider callback timeout. A concrete missed assertion is verifying that the funding source is debited only after the wallet is credited. A concrete bug this test would miss is if the system debits the funding source before crediting the wallet or if the FX rate changes after initiation but before settlement, violating the fx_lock requirement.
missingAssertions: Verify FX rate is locked at the moment top-up is initiated
Verify funding source is debited only after destination wallet is credited
Verify that top-ups above SGD 10,000 require approval from a second business owner before settlement
hypothesizedBugThisWouldMiss: If the system debits the funding source before crediting the wallet, this test would not detect it because it only checks the wallet balance increase and not the order of debit and credit operations.

suggestedReplacement.description: Verify wallet top-up behavior including FX rate lock, credit-before-debit order, and dual approval for large amounts
steps: Initiate top-up of SGD 500 and record FX rate at initiation
Verify FX rate used for conversion matches recorded FX rate
Verify destination wallet balance increases by SGD 500 equivalent
Verify funding source is debited only after wallet credit is confirmed
Verify that second business owner approval is requested before settlement
Verify wallet balance increases by SGD 15,000 equivalent
Verify funding source is debited after wallet credit
Simulate payment provider callback timeout during top-up
Verify transaction is rolled back and neither wallet nor funding source is affected
suggestedReplacement.expectedResult: FX rate is locked at initiation; destination wallet is credited before funding source is debited; top-ups above SGD 10,000 require second-owner approval before settlement; wallet balance increases accordingly; transaction rolls back on payment provider callback timeout
